title: Family Portrait Outside Brick Building, 1949 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white outdoor snapshot taken on June 14, 1949, showing a family of three standing beside a brick building. The family consists of a mother, a teenage daughter, and a father posed closely together with arms around each other and smiling at the camera. The women wear typical late-1940s summer dresses and open-toed sandals, while the man wears a collared shirt with rolled-up sleeves and dark trousers with a belt. The setting reflects mid-20th-century post-war American domestic life.
